test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four options have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
Things such as socks, shoes, gloves comes in pair. So it would be correct to say a pair of socks, a pair of shoes, a pair of gloves.

These are two identical items that are used together.

But to say a pair of sweaters, it would be incorrect. So it is the odd one out.

Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.
